mapper.select: SELECT pt.transaction_id, pt.account_id, pt.product_id, fp.product_name, pt.transaction_type, pt.quantity, pt.nav, pt.amount, pt.transaction_at FROM product_transaction pt JOIN financial_product fp ON pt.product_id = fp.product_id JOIN account_link al ON al.account_id = pt.account_id WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY pt.transaction_at DESC LIMIT 30
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_transaction(account_id, product_id, transaction_type, quantity, nav, amount, transaction_at) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{productId}, #{transactionType}, #{quantity}, #{nav}, #{amount}, #{transactionAt})
